soundMemoryMatch.manifestDescription: Flip the tiles and find the matching sound pairs — listen closely!
soundMemoryMatch.prompt: Listen and find the matching pairs!
soundMemoryMatch.howToPlay: Flip two tiles at a time — each one plays a sound instead of showing a picture. Listen closely and find all the matching pairs by ear!

goodEar.name: Good Ear
goodEar.desc: Finish a board with almost no wasted flips.

listeningStreak.name: Listening Streak
listeningStreak.desc: Match 3 pairs in a row without a miss.
